verdict.rationale: Jitsu's own recurring work is connector syncs, which run as Kubernetes CronJobs in self-hosted deployments [jitsu-docs-41]. Syncs can be managed through the Management API [jitsu-docs-61], and sync tasks and warehouse batch jobs are recurring jobs that trigger failure and recovery alerts [jitsu-docs-65]. However, the scheduling is limited to data-sync and batch loading, not general jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable schedules or cron expressions for syncs, scheduling of arbitrary workflows or Functions, exposure of scheduling through MCP or the CLI for AI agents, and independent corroboration.
